answer: Bonded stake at the quay: each agent must post collateral — a keel weight tied to a shared wharf — before its vote counts as a signal. To forge a thousand identities, an attacker must fund a thousand separate bonds; one proven act of fraud forfeits every bond traceable to that actor. Standing on that ledge of shared liability, sybil clusters become costlier than honest participation, so fabricating voices stops paying.
